criteria.clientCredentialsRefused: the portal client refuses a client-credentials grant
criteria.controlPlaneConfigurationBound: the issuer, client id and trusted keys come from the control plane's own configuration, whose bytes are hashed into this report
criteria.controlPlaneRejectsBadToken: GET /v1/session with a signed-but-invalid bearer answers 401 as canonical ProblemDetails with code AUTH-0050
criteria.controlPlaneRejectsMissingToken: GET /v1/session with no Authorization answers the same canonical 401
criteria.idpDiscoveryIssuer: the announced issuer equals the configured issuer, on the same origin
criteria.idpHttpsVerified: TLS to the issuer's own host verifies against an allowed internal root, with hostname checking on
criteria.idpJwksMatchesTrustBundle: the signing keys the provider serves are the keys the control plane trusts
criteria.idpNameResolves: the system resolver finds the issuer's host; no substitute is accepted
criteria.passwordGrantRefused: the portal client refuses a password grant (synthetic account only)
criteria.portalClientKnown: the configured client id is known to the provider
